title: Comparative evaluation result
description: The output of one evaluation run. Productivity is reported as a vector, never a single number, across the three-arm comparison. The implied evidence-ladder state is derived from the design, not from a favourable headline.

task_set.description: Identifier of the registered task set the arms were run on.

design.description: The evaluation design. Determines the strongest evidence-ladder state the result can support.

arms.description: One entry per comparison arm. A benchmark design may run only the two agent arms; a controlled/field design should include the no-agent baseline where feasible.

arm.description: Which of the three arms this is.

n.description: Number of tasks/participants in this arm.

acceptance_pass_rate.description: Fraction of tasks whose fresh output passed the acceptance graders (0..1).

taskset_passed.description: True when the agent_with_protocol arm's FRESH outputs passed the acceptance tests on this live run — the evidence that justifies the TASKSET_PASSED assurance rung.

runner.description: Provenance binding the result to a runner, model(s), tasks, and captured outputs.

tasks_sha256.description: Hash of the task-set inputs + graders.

outputs_sha256.description: Hash of the captured raw outputs file.

limitations.description: What this evaluation does not establish. Required for any design above benchmark.

implied_evidence_status.description: The evidence-ladder state this result supports. The harness caps this at the ceiling allowed by 'design'; a benchmark can never imply CAUSAL_EFFECT_SUPPORTED.

vector.description: The productivity vector. Report every dimension you measured; leave the rest null rather than guessing. Do not collapse into a scalar unless weights are declared for a specific decision.

completion.description: Fraction of tasks completed to the acceptance standard (0..1).

accuracy.description: 1 minus material-error rate (0..1); material errors and unsupported claims.

human_effort_min.description: Active human minutes: attention, interventions, review.

rework.description: Corrections required after first delivery (count or fraction).

cognitive_burden.description: User-rated difficulty/interruption load (normalised 0..1; lower is better).

accessibility.description: Success rate across differing skill levels/assistive needs (0..1).

safety_events.description: Privacy events, unintended external actions, policy violations. Any non-zero value is a headline, not a footnote.
